title: Blues singers and the popularity of the blues
summary: He says blues were everywhere before World War I, played in little back-room dance places; she says whites could not catch the feel.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues
